title: ThrowBlock
description: Brings back old Spawn eggs, Ghast and Clouds
body:
**A simple and lightweight resourcepack that brings back some Pre-1.21.6 features** 

-Old clouds

-Old ghast texture (and applies the same model _to the new happy ghast too!_)

-Old spawn eggs (with plans to add new eggs in the same style for new future minecraft mobs)
